segments.en: The Mahāvaipulya Sūtra, Buddhāvataṃsaka, bam po 18.
segments.zh_raw: 《佛說大毘盧遮那成佛神變加持經》（或譯《佛說大不思議經》）大廣博部，第十八卷。
segments.zh_raw2: 《佛說大毘盧遮那成佛神變加持經》（或譯《佛說大不思議經》）大廣博部，第十八卷。
segments.en_raw: The Mahāvaipulya Sūtra, Buddhāvataṃsaka, bam po 18.

segments.zh:
廣博功德之境界，清淨無垢之眾生。
如是言已，文殊師利菩薩，
向彼聖者善德吉祥，請問覺悟之種種功德。
segments.en: Having spoken thus, Mañjughoṣa, whose sphere of activity is the vastness of qualities and who is utterly pure, questioned the stainless being, the sublime and noble Śrīsaṃbhava, regarding the qualities of awakening.

segments.zh: 我在此為諸佛子，宣說諸佛清淨行境與種種行持。
segments.en: I shall here explain to the sons of the Victors the various modes of conduct of the Victors, whose spheres of activity are completely pure.

segments.zh: 凡是一切所具備的功德行持，請您現在為諸位佛子宣說。
segments.en: Now, tell the sons of the Conquerors whatever qualities and modes of conduct there may be.

segments.en_raw2: Now, tell the sons of the Conquerors whatever qualities and modes of conduct there may be.

segments.zh:
善吉祥言：佛子請聽。
彼等無量功德，僅就其功德中，
如從大海取一滴水，我當略述其少分。
segments.en: Bhadraśrī said: Listen, O Son of the Conqueror! From among those infinite qualities, I shall describe a mere fraction, just as a single drop from an ocean, merely to provide a brief introduction.
